craft_notes: Sthāyin: presiding needed. Rows: source then failure. Rejected: station-master invention — killed: not in L3. Read aloud: lever.

lines: And that stirring from the category-lords' presiding alone —
else toward fixed man it would not speed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa ca kṣobhaḥ prakṛtes tattveśādhiṣṭhānād eva anyathā niyataṃ puruṣaṃ prati iti na sidhyet
